storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Beware: a siren's mesmerizing charm lurks under her seemingly calm and rational words. Never show curiosity towards the unique appearance beneath her malformed helmet; never forget her long-lasting dissatisfaction with this humanoid body.

Her gleaming light once lured moths to its molten warmth. Her burning fire once guided the lost to their doom. Now, only confusion flickers in her lighthouse.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
The past three years have seen a large number of shipwreck incidents in the Monge Triangle sea area, accompanied by several cases of totally missing.

According to a sailor's testimony, a "woman with a glowing head" has been witnessed on the deck of the victim vessel during the rescue operation.

The field investigators rushed to the Monge Triangle sea area, but his ship had lost contact after arrivial. When the reinforcements finally found the spearhead ship, it had already lost power, drifting by the current towards the center of the Monge Triangle. All crew members were severely dehydrated and feeble. Massive hallucinations with acute intensity have been reported.

During the medical examination of the crew, a Silvercore was found among Investigator Ivors' personal belongings. The investigator himself consistently denied any contact between the ship and any Awakener.

The Silvercore was later sealed by the Awakener Department, numbered 6291-S-S-01, scheduled to use as teaching materials for pre-investigators in A.F. 315.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Like a real lighthouse, most of the time her presence is nothing more than a steady glow at a corner, peaceful, isolated. Her words only illuminates when confusion stirs the air, while her guidances clearer than nautical navigation.

Only when she meets with other Aequor visitors does the light reveal her shadow, twisting under paranoid madness.

In contrast to her serene and intellectual appearance, Faros has unexpectedly profound knowledge in ocean voyages. Despite the unresolved suspicions of abducting and sacrificing sailors, she has assisted the university in revising numerous nautical documents under the Keeper's supervision.

According to feedback from sailors of cooperative vessels, Faros's revisions, though effective, often (though not clear whether she is intentionally or not) steer the course towards the Monge Triangle.

The university has then prohibited Faros from accessing any ocean-related materials.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
The radiance of devotion illuminates her pilgrimage. A glorious ascension for the most devout follower of her true lord. A golden promise for the most loyal subject of her king.

It collapses. The Divine Realm is a sinking lie, a fortress without foundation, a vine drifting away from its soil. Her dolor billows. Her desolation turmoils. The remaining faith in the Divine Realm cannot keeps Faros afloat anymore. The poor wanderer eventually drowned.

Diving deep into the sea, her love and hatred agitates into swelling waves. The water whirls and spumes and eddies, splendor as the ceremony fireworks in her memory, a festival almost like a solace.

Her final torched gaze before being beheaded by the hero, must have been cling to the Divine Realm she couldn't forgo.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Return to her home, trace back to her origin, reunion with her lost dreamshe doesn't care how does her wish reflect in people's words. Even her body has altered to an Awakener, tides of her homeland still clamor in her soul.

The breath of sea-bottom volcanoes dissipated from her ears. The ocean's dreams writhing with ecstasies obscured from her eyes. Only her obsession with the Divine Realm still gleaming, more glorious than ever.

Mind her docility, a mere temporarily disguise. Her king's throne calls to her, like a lighthouse reaches through the aeons; her sacrifice will always be everything, like a wick's devotion to the light.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Faros greets you. Summoning me here must mean that you are ready to set sail.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: My connection to the homeland has grown stronger.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: The everlasting lamp...

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: It's getting brighter.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Do you trust me that much?

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I felt the breeze, carrying fine sand across my feet.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Can my departed kins find their way back home, following this light?

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: The salty sea breeze tells me that my homeland is not far away.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: I will only shine for my homeland. As for you...

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: I have been searching for tens of thousands of years; a fleeting century is nothing in comparison. Until you reach the end of your life, I will continue to assist you.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Would you like heading out to sea with me? Let me check the current map... 47°9' S, 126°43' W, we'll be going right there.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Are you planning to sail soon? Could you grant my humble request and let me join you? Just let me reach the sea...

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: If you still trust me, please allow me to be the guiding light on this journey. However, even in such a simple task, I have failed before...

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: I caused many disasters in the past, even nearly bringing destruction to certain civilizations... If I say it wasn't intentional, is it already too late?

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content:
I am the guardian of the entrance to the Eternal Kingdom, guiding those who return home. How ironic that I, with such a duty, have forgotten the way back...
Will you... be my beacon?

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: You seem curious about the appearance of my current vessel? Don't overthink it. I was born with a human face.

daily.title: Chat: About Eternal Kingdom
daily.content: My homeland worships our God. Correspondingly, the King I follow is naturally a "divine communicator."

daily.title: Chat: About Tulu
daily.content: Ah... His brilliance is so intense and dazzling, impossible to ignore! It was a foolish zeal that clouded my senses... No, I will not make any excuses for my stupidity...

daily.title: Chat: About Winkle
daily.content: She often stays close to me at night. Is it simply because my head is too conspicuous?

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Dissolution brings chaos and disasters. Perhaps my homeland sank into the deep sea because of it...

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Here, I often sense the presence of my Lord, but perhaps I am not yet ready to face Him... In any case, thank you for offering me shelter.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I love the sea. Is it ironic? Everything I owned is now sunken in the deep sea...

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: I hate the sea, and for good reason. The ocean devoured everything I loved...

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: I will serve as your guiding light in the darkness, but not forever.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Feel honored, for the gates to the Eternal Kingdom are here!

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: I hope that next time, my homeland will answer my call.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: The gates of my homeland are drifting away... No... Not again...

battle.title: Skill: II
battle.content: This undercurrent will tear our enemies apart.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Behold the magnificence of the Eternal Kingdom!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: No one can stop my steps toward seeking the homeland!
